name: Aperture Open
description: A camera iris of eight satin-black blades, closed on frame 0, opens on the photo (3 -> 17, the shutter on 6) while the picture settles from soft and dim to sharp; the caption (label kicker, text, subtitle) rises lower left from 16; the iris closes on the picture over the last 11 frames. A portrait photo sits whole over a blurred copy of itself.

sample.label: Lake Powell
sample.subtitle: One of the largest natural bridges on Earth

name: Slit of Light
description: A line of warm light grows across the black (1 -> 10) and splits into a band that opens on the photo (10 -> 25, the whoosh on 10), its lit edges fading as it opens; the caption rises lower left from 20. At the exit the band closes back to the line over the footage.

name: Colour Bloom
description: The photo in black and white; from frame 4 its colour spreads back out of the point (overlay.anchor, else the upper middle) like a wash, half way at 18 (a shimmer), the whole frame by 34, while the camera pushes slowly; the caption rises lower left from 22. For a line about something coming back.

name: Diagonal Slices
description: The photo arrives as five slanted slices sliding in along their own edges, from above and below in turn (0 -> 24, the first landing at 10), the gaps closing 18 -> 30 into one picture that keeps pushing; the caption rises lower left from 26. At the exit the slices slide out the other way over the footage.

name: Waterline
description: Water rises over the photo to a level (overlay.anchor.y, else 0.4 of the frame) over 2 -> 26, the rock still reading through it; a dashed white waterline draws across (24 -> 38) and its tag rises at the right: the engineers' water-level mark, label (else text) in Anton, subtitle (a height said, '3,708 FT') under it; then the water drains away and the line stays. For a line about where the water used to stand.

name: Detail Inset
description: The picture dims as a white box draws round a detail (overlay.anchor {x, y[, r]}, 4 -> 14); an enlarged inset grows out of the box into the open half of the frame on two leader lines (12 -> 25, landing at 22), the label inside it low left (subtitle or label kicker in the accent, text in Anton). At the exit the inset folds back into the box.

name: Rangefinder Shot
description: The photo seen through a rangefinder's window: frame lines, the split-image circle coming together as it focuses (3 -> 16); the shutter blinks on frames 18-19 (the click) and the picture is there full frame under a soft flash; the caption rises lower left from 24.

name: Torn Strips
description: The print, torn into three strips with white fibrous edges, slides in from alternate sides (landing at 15, 19 and 23); the torn seams stay a little open, handmade; the caption rises lower left from 24. At the exit the strips slide out the way they came, over the footage.

sample.label: Arizona
sample.subtitle: The Colorado River below Glen Canyon Dam

name: Folded Print
description: A print folded in three rises onto a dark desk (0 -> 12); its front panel opens toward the viewer (5 -> 19) and the back one from behind (9 -> 23), shading as they turn; it lies open by 23 with its creases left in the paper; the caption rises from 24 under it; the camera leans in.

name: Field Journal
description: An open field notebook on a desk: the print drops onto the left page (2 -> 12) and two strips of tape go on (12 -> 16, the tape on 13); on the right page the name (text) is handwritten from 17, the subtitle after it, the label (a date or place) in the corner, and a pencil arrow draws from the words to the print.

name: Magazine Spread
description: A glossy magazine slides onto the desk and lands at 12, opened on its opener spread: the photo bled across both pages and the fold, the kicker (label) in the accent, the headline (text) in a serif and the deck (subtitle) in italic on the picture's own shade; a gloss sweeps across the page (10 -> 36) and the camera glides in.

sample.text: The Lake That Built the West
sample.label: Lake Powell
sample.subtitle: How a reservoir in the desert came to hold 26 million acre-feet

name: Postcard
description: A vintage postcard slides in on its back - POST CARD, a stamp of the picture, a postmark with the place and the year said, the subtitle handwritten - and turns over (12 -> 26, the flip on 22) onto the picture with its printed caption (text · label) in the white border, then settles. A portrait photo makes an upright card. At the exit it slides away up and to the left.

sample.subtitle: Rowed fifty miles up the canyon to see it

name: Contact Sheet
description: A black-and-white contact sheet - three strips of the roll, frame numbers on the film edge - on a dark desk; a red grease pencil boxes one frame (6 -> 18), the camera pushes into it (20 -> 38) as it turns into the photo in colour, full frame; the caption rises lower left from 40.

name: Negative to Print
description: The photo lies on a light table as a colour negative - orange film base, sprocket holes, its neighbours either side - drifting (0 -> 15); a flash flips it to the positive at 16 and the film falls away as it fills the frame (18 -> 34); the caption rises lower left from 34.

name: Darkroom Print
description: Under the red safelight a blank print in the developing tray comes up as a black-and-white picture (2 -> 22), the developer rocking over it; the room light comes on at 24 (the switch) and the camera leans in; the caption rises lower left from 28.

name: Slide Projector
description: A projector lamp lights an empty screen in a dark room; the slide drops in at 6 (the slide changer) with a flicker and pulls into focus by 22 through a beam of drifting dust, warm, falling off at the corners; the caption rises under the screen from 24.

name: Archive Scan
description: A faded, dusty print lies on a scanner's glass; the light bar runs down it (6 -> 26) and leaves it restored behind; the scan then fills the frame (28 -> 42; a portrait whole over its blurred copy); the caption rises lower left from 42.

name: Shutter Burst
description: Three frames of a burst, each closer on the point (overlay.anchor, else the middle): wide, the shutter blinks on 8-9, closer, blinks on 18-19, closest from 20 and still easing in; never closer than the picture's own pixels allow. The caption rises lower left from 22.

name: Album Page
description: A glassine interleaf lifts off an old album page (2 -> 17, clearing the print at 14): the deckle-edged print held in four black photo corners, a typed label under it (text, and the year said); the camera leans in.

name: Archive Stamp
description: An aged sepia print with a typed caption (text — year) slides onto the desk (0 -> 11); the stamp's shadow closes in and a red ARCHIVE rubber stamp (or a short label word) with the year comes down on its lower corner at 14, inked unevenly, the print giving a little under it; the camera leans in.

name: Book Plate
description: An old book lies open; its right-hand page turns over in 3D (2 -> 18, landing at ~16) onto a full-page photographic plate in a ruled frame, its caption set in small caps (text) and italic (subtitle or label) beneath; the camera leans in toward the plate.

name: Archive Envelope
description: A kraft archive envelope with a typed label (text, subtitle or label) and a red PHOTOGRAPH / DO NOT BEND stamp lies on the desk; the print slides half out of it (4 -> 20), then the envelope drops to the foot of the frame (16 -> 34) as the print settles above it, whole, the label still in view.

name: Drying Line
description: In a dim darkroom the print slides along the drying line on its wooden clothes-pegs and stops at 16 (the peg), swinging to rest; prints either side hang out of focus; the caption rises lower left from 22.

name: Dated Prints
description: Two or three prints (media) land in turn along a time rail, the last at 25, each over its date (items[i].label, in Anton) and an accent tick, the rail drawing across; the title (text) and kicker (label) sit top left. At the exit the prints slide away to the left.

name: Then / Now
description: The earlier picture (media[0]) fills the frame; a lit diagonal seam sweeps in from the left and settles in the middle (4 -> 20), the later picture (media[1]) on its right, each side's date (items[0] / items[1] label, else THEN / NOW) at its top corner, the title lower left; at the exit the seam runs on and the later picture takes the frame. One picture: its earlier side in sepia.
